mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the Federal Funds rate above 4% in the month prior to the decision is associated with a negative 20-day S&P 500 forward return due to higher discount rates eroding expected equity cash flows.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS crosses above 4.0% in the prior month
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not statistically different from zero (p > 0.05) during FEDFUNDS > 4.0% periods.

mechanism_narrative: Rising unemployment (UNRATE) below 5% for two consecutive months predicts a positive 60-day S&P 500 forward return as weak labor demand prompts equity risk-on sentiment.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns show no significant positive deviation from the prior 60-day average during UNRATE < 5% double-move episodes.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly surge in industrial production (INDPRO) above 112.0 triggers a positive 20-day S&P 500 return as it signals resilient supply-side momentum supporting equity valuation expansion.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative or flat despite INDPRO > 112.0, with p-value > 0.05 in a backtest.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in consumer price inflation (CPIAUCSL) below 219.0 for three months indicates a cooling inflation environment, which is associated with a positive 5-day S&P 500 forward return due to reduced policy rate uncertainty.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are not statistically positive (p > 0.05) during CPIAUCSL < 219.0 triple-move episodes.

mechanism_narrative: Consecutive months of rising payrolls (PAYEMS) above 137,000 while FEDFUNDS remains below 3.0% creates a positive 20-day S&P 500 return via expectations of sustained wage growth and accommodative policy.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS > 137000 AND FEDFUNDS < 3.0% for two consecutive months
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05) during the specified interaction window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline in industrial output (HOUST) below 1065 triggers a negative 20-day S&P 500 forward return as it reflects softening economic activity and risk aversion.
Note: Since RSAFS is the only demand-related series left, this is a threshold signal. (Actually, use HOUST as alternative below.)
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (p > 0.05) during HOUST < 1065 episodes.

mechanism_narrative: A sudden rise in unemployment (UNRATE) above 6.5% for one month predicts a negative 60-day S&P 500 forward return due to heightened risk aversion and reduced consumer spending.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative (p > 0.05) during UNRATE > 6.5% single-move episodes.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in GDP deflator proxy via INDPRO (as closest supply indicator) below 111.8 is associated with a positive 5-day S&P 500 forward return as it signals soft inflation and stable pricing.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05) during INDPRO < 111.8 triple-move episodes.
